I thought by check this box, I'd be able to walk through an event no matter where it is. But for my bridge event that I've placed over the water, It wont let me walk on.
I've made it "below characters", "same as", and all of the checks. I tried to use a tileset image before but when it wasnt working i switched to an event image and that still didnt work. I've tested it with a different event and i was able to walk through it. Is it because its on the water tileset which ive marked un-passable? Any help is appreciated

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
"through" disables all collision and passability checks for that event - but to work as a tile, the event needs to be included in passability checks.
it would also need to be set to below, not same as

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
An event can only be used to walk over impassable terrain if it simulates a passable terrain from the tileset. and that can only happen if the event is below characters (as it will always block the player if it is same as) and if it exists for passability.
and as I already mentioned, the "through" removes the event from all passability checks, so the checkbox needs to be off to use the event as a bridge.
